Hi Michael,

can you look this warning :

`Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-idn.c:506 proto_tree_add_int_format called for hf_idn_gts_sample - item type is FT_INT8 but call has len 16 `

`Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-idn.c:552 proto_tree_add_int_format called for hf_idn_gts_sample - item type is FT_INT8 but call has len 16`
I wonder if these should be FT_BYTES ?

I think so... but my question is why is this a "warning"?  Shouldn't this be an error level that prevents pipeline passing?

Addressed the datatype issue.

I think it usually is some kind of error when the selected bytes are longer than the width of the item type.  Here are the remaining warnings of that type.  I can try to look at these again - its is not always easy to find good protocol specifications to compare against though.

 ./tools/check_typed_item_calls.py | grep "but call has len"
